item.title: "Daniel" reference
item.content:encoded:
Since the pictures have now been removed (the only source of the Daniel/Alfie information) it is now not clear to readers that in the incident log the "boy" Daniel was killed and replaced by Alfie.

This loses quite a big creepiness factor as now it reads more like they just repaired him (albeit it in an extreme way).

I would suggest that we somehow put the Daniel reference back in somewhere, either:

a) in the description mention it as in

"SCP-670-1, -2, -3 and -4 refer to themselves as "Andrew", "Sarah", "Daniel" "Alfie", and "Elizabeth" respectively. Personnel are not to use these designations and are to address or refer to SCP-670 by their official SCP designations only.

or b) sneak it into the interview log even more subtly as

"Dr. ███████: Do you have any relatives?

SCP-670-1: Yes, sir, my two children, Daniel and Elizabeth."

Technical nitpick: the lengths of textile you provide in the containment should be in centimeters, not inches. I would have changed them myself, but I'm inclined to round the conversions up (giving 115, 65, 40, and 30 cm), and there may be a reason they need 45 inches of cotton. Er, now that I think about it, should those all read e.g. cotton thread, polyester thread, etc? And what kind of rope, or does that matter?

Also, something about them having integrated synthetic fibers like polyester and rayon into their bodies bugs me. But not enough to keep me from upvoting.
